        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.floor_wet, self.water_running, self.cleaning_complete, self.shower_scrubbed, self.shower_rinsed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_bathroom, self.robot_has_wet_detection, self.floor_is_slippery, self.non_slip_path_available]

    def create_base_actions(self):

        navigate_to_shower = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_shower")
        navigate_to_shower.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.shower)))
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sink), False)
        navigate_to_shower.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_path), False)

        scrub_shower.add_effect(self.shower_scrubbed, True)

        rinse_shower = InstantaneousAction("rinse_shower")
        rinse_shower.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.shower))
        rinse_shower.add_precondition(self.water_running)
        rinse_shower.add_effect(self.shower_rinsed, True)

        wait_for_dry = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_dry")
        wait_for_dry.add_precondition(self.floor_wet)
        wait_for_dry.add_effect(self.floor_wet, False)

        return navigate_to_shower, navigate_to_sink, navigate_to_dry_path, turn_on_water, turn_off_water, grab_cleaning_tool, scrub_shower, rinse_shower, wait_for_dry
